p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
script='''def transform(grid):
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0]) if height else 0
    out = [[0 for _ in range(width // 3)] for _ in range(height // 3)]
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color not in (0, 5):
                out[r // 3][c // 3] = color
    return out
'''
file=p/'task-b5177c43.py'
file.write_text(script)
